subject: Taxes
title: Can the World Agree on Tax?
description: One-minute skill: Can the World Agree on Tax?.

hook.text: 136 countries agreed to a 15% minimum tax. But agreeing and implementing are worlds apart.

buildup.text: The UN, OECD, and EU all push for tax cooperation.

discovery.text: Developing countries argue the OECD framework favors rich nations.

twist.text: Even within the EU, Ireland and Hungary blocked tax harmonization for years.

climax.text: Global tax agreement remains the hardest international challenge.

punchline.text: Money moves in seconds. Law moves in decades. That gap is the haven.

quiz.question: Why is global tax agreement so difficult to achieve?
options: Tax sovereignty and differing national interests create resistance
